note: Aggregated from raw Claude Code session JSONL transcripts. main_session = the orchestrating conversation (this repo's author). subprocess_claude_p = the 223 separate `claude -p --allowedTools Read` invocations spawned by bin/cli.mjs (87 round-1 ingest + 92 round-2 ingest + ~20 selfeval queries + round2/3 query reruns + demo test runs). cost_usd_estimate uses published per-model list pricing and Anthropic's standard cache multipliers (write 1h = 2x base input, write 5m = 1.25x, read = 0.1x base input) since the raw usage field does not include a direct dollar cost. Sonnet 5 priced at its intro rate ($2/$10 per MTok, in effect through 2026-08-31, which covers this session's date); Opus 5 has no intro rate.

subprocess_claude_p.note: claude -p defaults to Opus 5, not the parent session's Sonnet 5 -- unintentional and the dominant cost driver.
